scope: Selected standalone rally stages and geographic road recreations; no complete championship itinerary claimed.

routes.method: Current OSM forest-road loop visually matched to the public 2024 Conuco shakedown map and organizer start-area coordinates. Geographic road recreation, not the exact 6.79 km competitive stage: mapped southern forest-road alignments and game timing boundaries differ. No invented connections or repeated road edges. Widths and surface roughness estimated; DEM does not survey ruts or jumps.

Current OSM roads reconstructed through the organizer 2021 Safety Book Hell's Gate start, radio controls and finish (public mirror). The 9.18 km control snaps 6.3 m to its mapped junction to avoid a false spur. The sharp Buffalo Circuit/Gorge Road junction is real connected topology (OSM ways 35283035/35283037), not an overlapping road reversal. Geographic recreation, not a surveyed historic stage; widths, small bridges and roughness are approximate.

routes.method: Current OSM forest roads matched to the organizer 2010 Rally Guide 2 stage map and start/radio/finish coordinates. Geographic gravel-road recreation, not a surveyed 2010 stage; current road alignments and game timing lines differ. Naekawa radio controls are snapped up to 33 m to adjacent mapped junctions, avoiding off-road safety positions. Its sharp R3 junction is genuine connected topology (OSM ways 226201402/226201413). Road widths and roughness estimated.
